text.en:
The sum of sixty thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as an aid to the
Philippine Amateur Athletic Federation to defray the expenses of a competent athletic delegation to represent
the Philippines at the Eleventh Olympiad to be held in Berlin in the year nineteen hundred and thirty-six.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 31, 1935.
